app.name: Reply queue
login.title: Log in
login.prompt: Enter the dashboard password to see the drafts.
dash.connect_none: No Gmail account is connected yet. Once connected, new emails are read automatically and a reply is drafted for each.
dash.calendar_enable_text: To see your calendar and add events, connect your Google account once more so the calendar permission is granted too.
dash.reconnect_text: Your Google connection has expired, so new emails and the calendar can't be read. Connect the same account again; nothing is lost.
dash.nothing_upcoming: Nothing on your calendar for these days.
dash.draft_failed: The draft could not be written; open it and try again.
dash.empty_pending: No replies are waiting for approval. New emails are checked every few minutes.
dash.change_account_confirm: Connecting a different Gmail account deletes all tasks of the current account. Continue?
task.rewrite_placeholder: For example: make it shorter, more formal, say I will answer by Friday
task.subject: Subject
task.events_jump: {n} event(s) found in this conversation; add to calendar ↓
ev.none: No event with a clear date was found in this email.
ev.no_time_note: No time was found; if you leave it empty the event is added as an all-day event.
ev.tz_note: Note: this event's time is in {tz}, not your local time. The calendar shows it in your time automatically.
ev.clash: Conflict: you have “{title}” at this time ({time}).
ev.invite_check: Also send a calendar invitation to {name}
warning.date_format_ambiguous: The date format is ambiguous (day/month or month/day).
warning.year_missing: The email did not give a year; the year was guessed.
warning.timezone_guessed: The time zone was guessed from the place.
warning.conflicting_times: The email gives conflicting dates or times for this event.
warning.location_hidden: The exact location is not shown (for example, it is revealed after registration).
warning.am_pm_unclear: It is unclear whether the time is AM or PM.
warning.multi_day_unclear: It is unclear whether the event lasts one day or several.
flash.gmail_connect_failed: Connecting to Gmail failed. Please try again.
flash.gmail_connected: Gmail account {email} connected. New emails will appear here in a few minutes.
flash.poll_started: Checking the mailbox. Refresh the page in a few seconds.
flash.task_already_done: This task was already sent or rejected.
flash.reply_sent_with_events: Reply sent. A meeting was found in your reply; add it to the calendar if you like.
flash.regen_only_pending: Only waiting tasks can be rewritten.
flash.rejected: Task rejected. The email was left untouched in Gmail.
flash.events_none: No new events found in this email.
flash.event_already: This event was already added or dismissed.
flash.event_duplicate: This event was already in your calendar.
flash.event_added_invited: Added to the calendar and the invitation was sent.
flash.settings_bad_tz: This time zone is not recognised. Example: Europe/London
settings.title: Settings
settings.language_help: The language of the pages and of text the AI writes (such as summaries).
settings.timezone_help: All times are shown in this time zone. Use the standard name, for example Europe/London.
settings.timezone_default: If left empty, the server value ({tz}) is used.
changelog.title: Changelog
task.no_reply_needed: This email does not need a reply, so no draft was written.
task.forward_note: It is a forwarded message. A reply would only go to the person who forwarded it, so none was drafted.
ev.cancelled_note: The email says this event was cancelled, so it cannot be added to the calendar.
dash.empty_events: No upcoming events were found in your emails.
dash.empty_other_mail: No other mail. Emails that need no reply show up here with a short summary.
flash.marked_done: Marked as done. It is archived here only; the email in Gmail is untouched.
flash.draft_ready: A reply draft is ready. Review it before sending.
js.failed: Something went wrong. Please try again.
task.delete_confirm: Delete this email from the dashboard? This cannot be undone. The email stays in Gmail.
flash.deleted: Email deleted from the dashboard. It was left untouched in Gmail.
flash.delete_busy: This reply is being sent right now. Try again in a moment.
film.title: Film dashboard: review
film.intro: Funds and events found on official pages. Check each one against its quotes, then approve or reject it. Nothing is shown on the website until it is approved.
film_open.label: Open to:
film.not_configured: The film dashboard database is not connected. Set FILMDASH_DATABASE_URL in .env (see pipeline/README.md).
film.unreachable: The film dashboard database cannot be reached right now. Check that its container is running.
film.approve_help: Approved records are shown on the website's opportunities page. Rejected ones are never shown.
film.no_dates: No dates were found on the page.
flash.film_unavailable: The film dashboard database cannot be reached right now.
req.title: Website requests
req.intro: Requests sent through the website form. Each one gets suggestions from the published funds and events. Nothing is sent to the visitor or an organiser until you press a button.
req.not_configured: Set FILMDASH_DATABASE_URL in .env to see the website requests.
req.unreachable: The database cannot be reached right now.
req.no_table: The website has not created its requests table in this database yet.
req.links_note: Shared by the visitor. They open on the other site; check the address before you sign in anywhere.
req.not_matched: No suggestions yet. They are made automatically within a few minutes, or press the button below.
req.no_matches: No published fund or event fits this request right now.
req.write_offer: Keep the ticked ones and write the email
req.manual_needs: Answer these needs yourself, there is nothing to match them with:
req.offer_sent_manual: Marked as sent from your own mail app on {when} (UTC).
req.subject: Subject
req.send_confirm: Send this email to the visitor now?
req.offer_help: Edit the text if you want. It is sent from the website mailbox only when you press Send.
req.offer_help_manual: Sending from here is not set up (REQUESTS_MAIL_HOST). Open it in your mail app, send it, then press "I sent it".
req.wait_for_yes: Wait for the visitor's answer. When they reply yes, press the button.
req.form_pack: Ready to copy for the organiser's form
req.form_pack_help: Open the official page, fill its form with these details (copy each one, or all at once), then record it below.
req.form_note_placeholder: Note, e.g. which account was used or what was paid (optional)
req.form_registered_on: Registered on the organiser's site on {when}.
req.how_email: This one takes registrations by email. The email below goes to the organiser from the company address, with the visitor in copy and the film details they sent. Check it before sending.
req.how_site: This one is done on the organiser's site (an account and often a payment are needed). Do it together with the visitor, or let them do it with the link from the email.
flash.request_chosen: Choice saved and email written. Check it below.
flash.request_send_failed: The email could not be sent: {error}
rqmail.subject: About your request
rqmail.intro: Thank you for your request{film}. Based on what you wrote, these look like a good fit for you:
rqmail.how_email: Registration is by email: we can send it for you.
rqmail.how_filmfreeway: Registration is on FilmFreeway with your own account.
rqmail.how_site: Registration is on the organiser's website.
rqmail.next_step: Reply to this email with the numbers you want to go for, and we will help you with the registration.
rqreg.subject: Registration: {event} ({name})
rqreg.body:
Hello,

On behalf of the filmmaker below, we would like to register for {event}. The filmmaker ({email}) is in copy and has authorised us to submit this for them.

{facts}

Please reply to all with the next steps or anything else you need.

Thank you.
rqreg.name: Name
req.how_filmfreeway: This one is on FilmFreeway. It needs the visitor's own FilmFreeway account: do it together with them.
req.wait_for_confirm: Waiting for the visitor to choose on the website. Their answer appears here by itself.
req.confirmed_on: The visitor confirmed on {when} and accepted the terms (version {version}).
req.send_registration_confirm: Send this registration to the organiser now, with the visitor in copy?
req.no_replies_yet: No reply from the organiser yet.
req.tracking_off: Replies are not read automatically (REQUESTS_IMAP_HOST is not set). Check the company inbox.
rqmail.next_step_link: Choose the options you want and send your film details on this page. We only register you after that:
rqupd.subject: Update: {event}
rqupd.received: The organiser of {event} confirmed they received your registration.
rqupd.rejected: Unfortunately {event} did not accept the registration this time.
rqupd.needs_info: The organiser of {event} needs something more from you:
rqupd.other: There is news from the organiser of {event}:
stats.title: Website visits
stats.intro: Page views on the company website, counted without cookies. A visitor is counted once per day, so someone who comes back on another day counts again. Crawlers are not counted.
stats.no_referrers: No visits from other websites in this period. Direct visits and most apps send no referrer.
stats.empty: No visits counted in this period yet.
stats.not_configured: Set FILMDASH_DATABASE_URL in .env to see the website visits.
stats.unreachable: The database cannot be reached right now.
stats.no_table: The website has not created its visits table in this database yet (it does so on its next start after the update).
board.title: Task board
board.field.title: Task
board.no_people: First add the names of the people on this board on the Settings page.
board.drag_hint: Drag a card to another column, or use its arrow buttons.
board.move_failed: The card could not be moved. Reloading the page…
settings.board_people_help: Names separated by commas (up to 6). Every task belongs to one of them.
flash.board_bad: Write a title and choose an owner.
board.images_help: PNG, JPEG, GIF or WebP, up to 5 MB each and 10 per task. You can also paste a screenshot into the notes box, or drop files here.
flash.board_images_skipped: Saved, but {n} file(s) were not added: only PNG, JPEG, GIF or WebP pictures up to 5 MB, and at most 10 per task.
